title: Password Reset — Requesting a Reset
text: If you cannot log in to your account, navigate to the login page and click "Forgot your password?" below the sign-in form. Enter the email address associated with your account and submit the form. A password reset link will be sent to that email within a few minutes. If you do not see the email in your inbox, check your spam or junk folder. The link expires after 30 minutes.

title: Password Reset — Email Verification
text: Once you receive the password reset email, click the link inside. You will be taken to a secure verification page. If the link has expired, return to the login page and request a new one. For security reasons, each link can only be used once. If you have not received the email after five minutes and it is not in your spam folder, contact support with your account email address.

title: Password Reset — Choosing a New Password
text: After verifying your email, you will be prompted to enter and confirm a new password. Passwords must be at least twelve characters and include at least one number and one special character. Avoid reusing your previous password. Once submitted, you will be signed in automatically. For accounts protected by single sign-on (SSO), password resets must be handled through your identity provider, not the login page.

title: Subscription Cancellation — Finding the Option
text: To cancel your subscription, sign in and navigate to Settings > Billing > Subscription. You will see your current plan details along with a "Cancel plan" button. Only account Owners can cancel a subscription. If you are an Admin or Member, you will need to ask your account Owner to complete the cancellation. The option may not appear if your plan was purchased through a reseller or third-party marketplace.

title: Subscription Cancellation — Completing the Cancellation
text: Click "Cancel plan" and confirm when prompted. Your subscription will remain active until the end of the current billing period — you will not be charged again after that date. You will receive a confirmation email at the address on file. If you change your mind, you can reactivate from the same Billing settings page before the period expires.

title: Subscription Cancellation — Data After Cancellation
text: After your subscription ends, your data is retained for 30 days in a read-only state. During this window you can export your data or reactivate your plan. After 30 days, account data is permanently deleted and cannot be recovered. If your account was on an annual plan, the cancellation takes effect at the annual renewal date, not the monthly anniversary. Contact support if you need a copy of your data before deletion.

title: 2FA Setup — What Is Two-Factor Authentication
text: Two-factor authentication (2FA) adds a second layer of security to your account. In addition to your password, you must provide a one-time code each time you sign in from an unrecognized device. This protects your account even if your password is compromised. We support authenticator apps such as Google Authenticator, Authy, and 1Password. SMS-based 2FA is not supported. Enabling 2FA is optional for individual accounts but may be required by your organization's security policy.

title: 2FA Setup — Enabling Two-Factor Authentication
text: To enable 2FA, go to Settings > Security > Two-factor authentication and click "Enable". A QR code will be displayed. Open your authenticator app, tap "Add account", and scan the QR code. The app will begin generating six-digit codes that refresh every 30 seconds. Enter the current code to confirm setup. Once confirmed, 2FA is active and will be required on all future sign-ins from new or unrecognized devices.

title: 2FA Setup — Backup Codes
text: During 2FA setup you will be shown ten one-time backup codes. Download or print these and store them somewhere safe. Each code can be used once if you lose access to your authenticator app. After a code is used it is invalidated. If you lose both your authenticator app and all backup codes, you will need to contact support to verify your identity through an alternative process before access can be restored.

title: SSO/SAML — Prerequisites
text: Single sign-on (SSO) via SAML 2.0 is available on Business and Enterprise plans. Before configuring SSO, confirm that your identity provider (IdP) supports SAML 2.0. Common supported providers include Okta, Azure AD, Google Workspace, and OneLogin. You will need admin access to both your IdP and your account settings. Once SSO is enforced, all users in your organization must authenticate through the IdP and cannot use a password to sign in directly.

title: SSO/SAML — Configuring Your Identity Provider
text: In your account, navigate to Settings > Security > Single sign-on and copy the Service Provider Entity ID and Assertion Consumer Service URL. In your IdP, create a new SAML application and paste these values into the corresponding fields. Map the email attribute to the user's primary email address. Download the IdP metadata XML and upload it in your SSO settings page, or manually enter the IdP entity ID and certificate.

title: SSO/SAML — Testing and Enforcing SSO
text: Before enforcing SSO, use the "Test configuration" button to verify the SAML exchange works correctly. The test will sign in using your current session and confirm attribute mapping. If the test fails, check that the ACS URL and entity ID are entered correctly in your IdP and that the certificate has not expired. Once testing passes, you can optionally enforce SSO for all users, which prevents password-based logins for your domain.

title: Team Invitations — Sending an Invite
text: To invite a new team member, go to Settings > Team and click "Invite member". Enter the person's email address and select their role before sending. An invitation email is sent immediately. Invitations are valid for 7 days. If the invited person already has an account with that email, they will be added to your workspace after accepting. If not, they will be prompted to create a new account first.

title: Team Invitations — Pending Invitations
text: Pending invitations appear in Settings > Team under the "Pending" tab. You can resend or cancel an invitation from this view. Resending generates a new link and invalidates the previous one. An invitation is marked as expired after 7 days if not accepted. You will not be charged a seat for a pending invitation — charges only apply once an invitation is accepted and the user joins the workspace.

title: Team Invitations — Removing Access
text: To remove a team member, go to Settings > Team, find the user, and select "Remove". Their access is revoked immediately and they are signed out of all active sessions. Any data they created within the workspace remains and is not deleted. Pending invitations for removed users are automatically cancelled. If you need to transfer ownership of their work to another team member, do so before removing them.

title: Roles and Permissions — Available Roles
text: There are four roles in a workspace: Owner, Admin, Member, and Viewer. The Owner has full control including billing and account deletion. Admins can manage team members, settings, and integrations but cannot access billing or delete the account. Members can create and edit content but cannot change settings or invite others. Viewers have read-only access. Each workspace has exactly one Owner; all other roles can be assigned to multiple users.

title: Roles and Permissions — Changing Roles
text: To change a member's role, go to Settings > Team, find the user, and use the role dropdown. Only Owners and Admins can change roles. An Owner can transfer ownership to another member, which changes their own role to Admin. Role changes take effect immediately. If a member's role is downgraded to Viewer while they are actively working, they will receive a notification and lose edit access on their next action.

title: Roles and Permissions — Permission Inheritance
text: Permissions apply at the workspace level by default. Admins cannot grant permissions beyond their own level — an Admin cannot promote another user to Owner. On Enterprise plans, some permissions can be scoped to individual projects or folders. Users with multiple workspace memberships carry separate role assignments for each workspace. Permissions granted by SSO group mappings may override manual role assignments when the user signs in through SSO.

title: Data Export — Requesting an Export
text: To export all data from your account, go to Settings > Privacy > Data export and click "Request export". Only Owners can request a full account export. The request is processed within 24 hours. You will receive an email notification when your export is ready. Exports include all workspace content, member activity logs, and billing history. The export link is valid for 48 hours and can only be downloaded once.

title: Data Export — Available Formats
text: Data is exported as a ZIP archive containing JSON files for structured data and Markdown or plain text for content. Attachments such as images and files are included in their original formats. For compliance purposes, the export also includes a machine-readable manifest listing every file with its metadata and checksum. CSV exports of specific tables are available separately from Settings > Privacy > Data export > Table exports.

title: Data Export — GDPR Rights
text: Under GDPR, residents of the European Economic Area have the right to receive a portable copy of their personal data. We aim to fulfill export requests within 72 hours. If you have a time-sensitive compliance requirement, contact support with the relevant deadline. After downloading your export, verify its completeness before deleting your account. Once an account is deleted, a retrospective export is not possible.

title: Billing Cycle — When You Are Billed
text: Your subscription renews automatically on the same calendar day each month or year. The billing date is determined by the date you first activated a paid plan. For example, upgrading on the 14th means you are charged on the 14th each month. View your next billing date at Settings > Billing > Subscription. If the date falls on a weekend or public holiday, the charge processes on the next business day.

title: Billing Cycle — Proration
text: If you upgrade your plan mid-cycle, you are charged a prorated amount for the remainder of the current period, plus the full amount for the next period. If you downgrade, the difference is applied as a credit to your next invoice rather than refunded. Proration is calculated to the nearest day. You can preview the prorated charge before confirming a plan change on the confirmation screen.

title: Billing Cycle — Changing Your Billing Date
text: Your billing date cannot be changed directly. However, if you switch from a monthly to an annual plan, the billing date resets to the date of the switch. If you need your billing date moved for business reasons, contact support. Seat additions mid-cycle are prorated using the same billing-date anchor. Switching payment currency requires cancelling and reactivating your plan, which resets the billing date.

title: Account Recovery (Lost 2FA Device)
text:
If you are locked out of your account because you no longer have access to your two-factor authentication device — for example, because your phone was lost, replaced, or reset — you can recover access using a backup code or by contacting support.

Using a backup code: When you originally set up 2FA, you were given ten one-time backup codes. If you saved these, enter one on the 2FA prompt instead of a time-based code. Each backup code can only be used once. After signing in, go to Settings > Security and re-enroll your new device in 2FA immediately, then generate a new set of backup codes.

If you do not have backup codes: Click "Try another method" on the 2FA screen, then "Use a backup code". If no backup codes are available, select "Contact support for account recovery". You will be asked to verify your identity using the email address registered to the account. A verification link will be sent to that email. If you no longer have access to that email address either, the recovery process requires additional verification steps and may take up to five business days.

Preventing lockouts in future: Always store your backup codes in a password manager or a secure offline location. If you get a new device, re-enroll the authenticator app before deactivating the old one. On Enterprise plans, administrators can bypass 2FA temporarily for a user from the admin console, which is faster than the support-assisted recovery process.

title: Account Deletion
text:
Deleting your account is permanent and cannot be undone. Before proceeding, make sure you have exported any data you want to keep, cancelled your subscription to avoid further charges, and transferred ownership of any workspaces where you are the sole Owner.

To delete your account: Go to Settings > Account > Delete account. You will be asked to type your email address to confirm. If your account is the sole Owner of any active workspace, you must either transfer ownership to another member or delete the workspace before you can delete your account. Accounts with active paid subscriptions cannot be deleted until the subscription is cancelled.

What is deleted: All personal data associated with your account is permanently removed, including your profile, login credentials, and any workspaces you owned. Content in workspaces where you were a member remains visible to other members under an anonymized display name. Billing history is retained for seven years for legal purposes but is no longer linked to your personal profile.

After deletion: You will be signed out of all sessions immediately and your email address will be released, allowing you to create a new account with the same email in the future. There is a 24-hour grace period during which deletion can be reversed by clicking the cancellation link in the confirmation email.

title: Refund Policy
text:
We offer refunds in specific circumstances. Understanding the policy before requesting a refund will help set accurate expectations.

Monthly subscriptions: Monthly plan charges are non-refundable once processed. If you cancel a monthly plan, access continues until the end of the billing period, but no partial refund is issued for unused days. We recommend cancelling before your next billing date to avoid being charged for the following month.

Annual subscriptions: If you cancel an annual plan within 14 days of the charge and have not used the service significantly during that period, you may be eligible for a full refund. After 14 days, annual plan charges are non-refundable. Significant usage is defined as encoding more than 500 documents, running more than 10 evaluations, or inviting more than 3 team members.

Billing errors: If you were charged an incorrect amount, charged after cancellation, or charged for a seat that was never activated, contact support within 30 days of the charge. We will investigate and issue a credit or refund if the error is confirmed.

How to request a refund: Contact support at support@example.com with your account email and the invoice number in question. Eligible refunds are processed within 5–10 business days and returned to the original payment method.

title: Invoice Download
text:
All invoices for your account are stored in Settings > Billing > Invoices. Each invoice includes the billing date, amount charged, plan name, number of seats, and any applicable taxes. Invoices are generated automatically on each billing date and are available for download as PDF files.

Downloading an invoice: Navigate to Settings > Billing > Invoices, find the invoice you need, and click "Download PDF". Invoices are available from the date your first paid subscription began. If you need invoices from before a paid plan began, those are not available as invoices are only generated for paid transactions.

Adding company details: If you need your company name, VAT number, or billing address to appear on invoices, add these in Settings > Billing > Billing information before the next invoice is generated. Changes apply to future invoices only. To update past invoices, contact support within 30 days of the invoice date.

Forwarding invoices: You can set an additional email address to receive invoice copies automatically in Settings > Billing > Invoice recipients. This is useful for forwarding invoices directly to a finance or accounting team without giving them access to the full account.

title: Payment Method Update
text:
You can update your credit or debit card, or switch to a different payment method, from Settings > Billing > Payment method. Only account Owners can make changes to payment information.

Updating your card: Click "Edit payment method", enter your new card details, and save. The new card becomes the default for all future charges immediately. If your current billing period is already in progress, the existing card is not re-charged; the new card will be used on the next billing date.

Failed payments: If a payment fails — for example, because a card expired — you will receive an email notification and a 7-day grace period to update your payment method. During this period your subscription remains active. If payment is not resolved within 7 days, access is suspended but your data is retained for 30 days.

Supported payment methods: We accept Visa, Mastercard, and American Express credit and debit cards. SEPA direct debit is available for annual plans in supported European countries. Bank transfers and purchase orders are available on Enterprise plans. PayPal and cryptocurrency are not accepted.

title: Storage Quota and Limits
text:
Each plan includes a storage allocation for documents, attachments, and evaluation artifacts. Understanding your usage and how limits are enforced will help you avoid unexpected disruptions.

Checking your usage: Current storage usage is shown in Settings > Account > Storage. The bar shows total used space across all workspaces you own. Storage is counted at the account level for Owners — all workspaces under a single Owner share the same quota. Usage figures update every hour.

What counts toward storage: Document uploads, image and file attachments, evaluation artifacts (run details, rankings, model caches), and exported data archives all count toward storage. The bundled example datasets provided by the application do not count toward your quota.

When you reach your limit: When usage reaches 90% of your quota, you will receive an email warning. At 100%, new uploads and evaluations are blocked, but existing data remains accessible and readable. To free up space, delete old run artifacts from Settings > Evaluations > Run history, or delete unused workspaces.

Increasing your quota: Storage limits are tied to your plan tier. Upgrading your plan increases your quota automatically. On Enterprise plans, additional storage can be purchased separately without changing the base plan.

title: Webhook Setup
text:
Webhooks allow your application to receive real-time notifications when specific events occur in your account. Instead of polling our API, your server receives an HTTP POST request each time a subscribed event is triggered.

Creating a webhook: Go to Settings > Integrations > Webhooks and click "Add webhook". Enter the endpoint URL where your server will receive events. The URL must be publicly accessible over HTTPS. Select the event types you want to subscribe to, then click "Save". A secret key is generated automatically — use it to verify that incoming requests originate from us.

Verifying webhook payloads: Each webhook request includes an X-Signature-256 header containing an HMAC-SHA256 hash of the request body, signed with your webhook secret. On your server, compute the same hash using your secret and compare it to the header value. Reject any request where the signatures do not match.

Event delivery and retries: We attempt to deliver each event up to five times with exponential backoff if your server returns a non-2xx status code or does not respond within 10 seconds. Events are delivered at least once; your server should handle duplicate deliveries idempotently using the event_id field in the payload.

Supported events: Evaluation completed, dataset generated, team member added or removed, subscription changed, and storage limit warning.
